all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The freshness-supersede guard (Classify != OtherBranch) also clears a pre-#178 branchless freshness row whose head is unreachable from HEAD (Orphaned), which may belong to an unmerged pre-#178 branch. A fresh same-target mutation run on another branch can supersede that legacy row; bounded to legacy freshness rows (overlaps mr-6jy).
